source_evidence_scope: sampled video frames only (count and spacing: material.frame_sampling); mechanism and transferability remain hypotheses

hook.text: The ad opens with a messy car trunk carpet covered in white debris while a handheld vacuum cleans a strip through it.

buyer_problem.text: Car interiors accumulate debris in carpets, seat crevices, and tight gaps that are hard to clean.

product_intervention.text: A portable black and yellow handheld car vacuum (brand SEESE) with multiple attachments is demonstrated cleaning various car surfaces.

result_demo.text: Frame 0 shows a visible clean strip on the carpet where the vacuum passed; frame 7 shows the clear dust container filled with collected debris; frame 5 shows debris being sucked from a seat crevice.

cta.text: Hit the yellow card to purchase (from ad title text).

mechanism_hypothesis.text: The handheld vacuum uses motorized suction to pull debris into a removable transparent dust container, with interchangeable nozzles for different surfaces and gaps.

transferability.text: The vacuum appears transferable to home cleaning, as shown by the cereal-on-wood-floor scene, suggesting use beyond just car interiors.

evidence.observation: A hand operates the vacuum on a debris-covered trunk carpet, leaving a visibly clean strip behind the nozzle while surrounding areas remain dirty.
The vacuum is held upright showing the SEESE branding and yellow accent button, with debris still visible on the carpet behind it.
Open product box displays the vacuum and accessories in foam packaging with a $40 price graphic and crying Pepe meme.
The same box is shown with a surprised Pepe meme and exclamation marks; a hand points at the vacuum and accessories inside.
A black leather car seat is covered in colorful confetti-like debris, with a hand pointing to the mess in the seat crevice.
The vacuum nozzle is inserted into the seat crevice, actively removing debris from between the seat sections.
The vacuum reaches into a narrow gap in the car interior, suctioning colorful debris from a tight space.
The vacuum is held upright with the transparent dust container visibly filled with collected debris and dust.
Cereal or oat debris is scattered on a wooden floor with the vacuum nozzle positioned nearby, suggesting home use beyond cars.
The open box displays all included accessories (nozzles, brush, charging cable) arranged in custom foam cutouts; a hand points at the contents.

limits.text: No audio or spoken claims are available; no direct before/after static shot of the same surface fully cleaned; no battery life, suction power, or runtime specifications are visible; the final frame shows packaging but not a fully clean car interior.
missing: full before/after comparison of entire car interior
